text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Time passes in the blink of an eye until
soon
enough, the new year is upon us.
While the
students are on winter
vacation...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Here you are, one salt ramen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I track down a ramen shop that's open
on the first
of January, and sit down to
review our training
regimen over a hot
meal.
choice_data_list: ありがとうございます！
choice_data_list_en: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what have we here? Fu's trainer,
kicking off
the new year with a business
lunch?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin is raring to take on the Classic
Triple
Crown—a series comprising the
Satsuki Sho,
Japanese Derby, and
Kikuka Sho. It's a
once-in-a-lifetime
opportunity for any racer.
choice_data_list: はい、今年からクラシック級なので
choice_data_list_en: Yes, because she's entering the Classic Class this year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I imagine she'll face stiff competition in
all three
races. If we're going to stand a
chance of winning,
her hard work alone
won't cut it...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...!
I see.
choice_data_list: 二人三脚で走るって約束しましたから！
choice_data_list_en: Because we promised we'd run together in lockstep!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
All right, have another egg—on the
house. Get in
some extra nutrients
before you go see Fu!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I leave, the ramen shop owner tips me
off to
Ines Fujin's whereabouts, and sure
enough, I find
her at the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year! There are two more
lines
available on the right, so please—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, were you hoping to see me in shrine
maiden
getup? Aw, too bad! I'm doing
crowd control
today!
choice_data_list: ここでバイトしてるって聞いて
choice_data_list_en: I heard you were working a part-time job here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So how come you're here? I'm pretty
surprised
you came to see me while I'm
on the job.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Is there some kind of emergency? Or
maybe...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You're here to convince me that the time
I spend
working is time wasted?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Haha. I guess I should have
expected that...
choice_data_list: そう、もったいなくて！！
choice_data_list_en: Right, it feels like such a waste to use!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: バイト中の行動も練習に生かせないかな！？
choice_data_list_en: Can't we apply what you do during work to training too?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pulling out my files, I show her the
regimen I
made over winter vacation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lately, her peers are getting better and
better at
late surges. If she's going to
make a successful
getaway, we have to
exhaust the competition's
energy
reserves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want her to learn how to
manipulate
the pace of her opponents.
For example, she
should be able to...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: 参拝客の列の流れを支配できるような！
choice_data_list_en: Like being able to control the entire flow of shrine visitors!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well... I just don't see how what you
were saying
has anything to do with
organizing all these
people.
choice_data_list: ……やっぱり無理があるかな？
choice_data_list_en: ...Is it a bit too much of a stretch after all?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeahhh.
choice_data_list: そっか～……
choice_data_list_en: I see~...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. So you want my work shifts to
double up
as training shifts, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. This is just a hunch, based
on how
enthusiastic you are about all
this, but... I'm
guessing that's not the
only idea you've come up
with, is it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. This is just a hunch, based
on how
enthusiastic you are about all
this, but... I'm
guessing that's not the
only idea you've come up
with, is it?
choice_data_list: スピードアップする方法をとにかく試す！
俺、しんきゅう院でバイトを始めようと思う
私、しんきゅう院でバイトを始めようと思う
ポスティング中にコース取りの意識を！
choice_data_list_en: Try whatever it takes to boost speed!
I'm thinking of starting a part-time job at an acupuncture clinic.
I'm thinking of starting a part-time job at an acupuncture clinic.
Be mindful of your course positioning while delivering fliers!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: スピードアップする方法をとにかく試す！
俺、しんきゅう院でバイトを始めようと思う
私、しんきゅう院でバイトを始めようと思う
ポスティング中にコース取りの意識を！
choice_data_list_en: Try whatever it takes to boost speed!
I'm thinking of starting a part-time job at an acupuncture clinic.
I'm thinking of starting a part-time job at an acupuncture clinic.
Be mindful of your course positioning while delivering fliers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Strength training isn't the only way we
can boost
her speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lightening the load on her shoes could
work, and
so could performing tooth
maintenance that'll
help her keep her
teeth clenched during races...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, now I get it. Well, we can test all
those out.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whew. Tomorrow's going to be one busy
day.
choice_data_list: そう！
choice_data_list_en: Exactly!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You want to get a part-time job too?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But if I can get to know the doctors at a

treatment facility, I might be able to
request
mobile medical services after
training and before
races.
choice_data_list: 受付のバイトだけど……
choice_data_list_en: It's just a part-time reception job, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Recently, I've noticed that Ines Fujin has
been
straining her back muscles. If I can
do anything to
alleviate that burden...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You're such a dummy.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm going to be straight with you.
If you're
that worried, let's just schedule
some proper
hospital visits.
choice_data_list: 結構本気だよ！！
choice_data_list_en: I'm being totally serious!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I can adjust my work hours if you let me
know the
plan ahead of time, and this'd
be way simpler
than you picking up
another job.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...You really do put me first, don't you?
And
worry a lot while you're at it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! That sounds like a pretty good
idea! Let's
start tomorrow morning!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Haha. Don't get carried away now.
choice_data_list: だろう！？
でしょう！？
choice_data_list_en: Right?!
Right?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, bend down for a second. Your
shoelaces
are untied.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Nope, just kidding.
choice_data_list: 本当！？
choice_data_list_en: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A moment later, I feel two gentle pats
on my
head.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But you've really thought long and hard
about
this! So you get a gold star! Great
job!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...A show of gratitude. That's all.
choice_data_list: えっと、これは……
choice_data_list_en: Um, this is...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you know, all of your ideas are
built
around my part-time work.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You did?
choice_data_list: だって君に誓ったから
だって貴方に誓ったから
choice_data_list_en: Because I made a vow to you.
Because I made a vow to you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Ines Fujin loves to run. But she loves
her family
just as much.
choice_data_list: 君の大切なものなら、俺も大切にしたい
貴方の大切なものなら、私も大切にしたい
choice_data_list_en: If it's precious to you, I want to cherish it too.
If it's precious to you, I want to cherish it too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If working part-time is how she wants to
support
her sisters, then I have no
business interfering.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: 俺は楽しそうに走る君が好きなんだ
私は楽しそうに走る貴方が好きなんだ
choice_data_list_en: I love seeing you run when you're having fun.
I love seeing you run with a smile on your face.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing me enjoy running, huh. Hehe, is
that so.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Then maybe I'll take this opportunity to
make
some self-centered requests! Like
when the
Classic Triple Crown is over, I
might just ask to
compete in an even
bigger race. ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And I mean without quitting any of my jobs. I don't want to lose a single thing, you know?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Will you still like me if I start saying
crazy things
like that?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sappy line acquired! Ahaha, I was
hoping you'd
say that. Another win for
me!
choice_data_list: ああ、必ず君をサポートする！
うん、必ず貴方をサポートする！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, I'll support you no matter what!
Yeah, I'll definitely support you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right. Then here's to another great
year,
Trainer!
